title: Destiny of Darkness
text: Well then… I traveled through another portal. It wasn’t the “hour of the Ox” when even plants and trees sleep… but it was still a bit too early to go to bed—around 9:00, to be exact. I went to the Filolial stable at a certain ranch.

Looking at that Filolial stable… ah, just as I thought. I noticed a spot a little ways away from the other Filolial-samas where the surrounding wall was worn down. There… was a pitch-black Filolial-sama named Black Thunder. From the looks of it, he seemed to be a youngster on the verge of adulthood.
“Gua?”
The Filolial-samas in the pen, who had been about to fall asleep, raised their little heads to look at me, a stranger.
“Good evening.”
“Gua?”
I offered them some dried meat and fruit, as if they were gifts.
“Gua!”

The Filolial-sama’s eyes light up with interest in this unexpected feast, and they begin to eat. Unfazed by the commotion, Black Thunder sits in his enclosure, looking distinctly displeased. After giving the Filolial-sama a light stroke, I make my way over to Black Thunder.
“Gua?”

Sensing my approach, Black Thunder looked up with a displeased expression and glared at me. Black Thunder is a bit of a grouch—unless you’re Kuro-chan, that is… no, he’s just in a bad mood until he comes to understand his own way of life. But I understand the kind of atmosphere Black Thunder likes!
“Black Thunder, is it! I, Motoyasu Kitamura, The Love Hunter, have come to bestow upon you the destiny—the ‘Sadame’—to soar from the mundane world into the realm of darkness!”
“Gua!?”

At my unexpected words, Black Thunder let out a cry of surprise, and at the same time, his eyes began to sparkle. As Black Thunder approached, I showed him the footage of Ren I’d recorded on the video crystal.
“Gwaaaaah…”
Black Thunder stared intently at the footage of Ren swinging his sword in battle.
“This is your chosen partner—the ‘Shadow S'yne’—before his awakening. Do you understand?”
“Gua! Guaaaa!”
Black Thunder stood up excitedly and nodded repeatedly.

“However, this guy hasn’t the slightest clue about his own destiny yet. To hasten his awakening, I’ve come to bestow the power of darkness upon you! Once you’ve drawn out his full potential, you’re the one who’ll awaken him! Do you understand?”
When I held out my hand, Black Thunder looked back and forth between my hand and my face several times before nodding.
“Gua!”
All right! I’ve got Black Thunder’s approval.
“W-who is that?　What are you doing to the Filolials here…? T-that’s a rampaging Filolial! It’s dangerous! Do you want to die?!”
The owner of this Filolial ranch must have overheard our conversation and come over. By the way, this isn’t the owner of the Filolial ranch I usually patronize.
“Ah, my apologies for disturbing you so late at night. My name is Motoyasu Kitamura, The Love Hunter.”
I flaunted my spear at just the right moment and said this with a bit of a victory pose. Then Black Thunder joined in, spreading his wings behind me.
“Guaa!”
“W-Wait, Kurotaro… is actually trusting a human? Who on earth are you…?”

Huh? Kurotaro? Is that Black Thunder’s real name? There’s a lot I don’t know—like Fleon-chan’s origins and the Immortals—but this is the first time I’ve heard that “Black Thunder” was an alias. But even in this world, he’s still Kuro-chan, isn’t he?
“Gua! Gua-gua-gua!”
“I get it, I get it! So it was Black Thunder… You put the letters together to make your name, didn’t you…”
Apparently, “Black Thunder” is his real name, too. It seems he came up with it himself.
“I’m The Love Hunter. By the way, I have a favor to ask—would you be willing to let me have this Black Thunder?”
“Gua!”
The ranch owner looked at me and Black Thunder, then…
“That’s Filolial—he’s been a real handful because he’s so hot-tempered. If you’re willing to buy him, I’d be more than happy to sell…”
And so, the rancher gladly sold Black Thunder to me. Of course, it wasn’t for free. I paid a fair price to acquire Black Thunder. I immediately registered Black Thunder as my companion.

“My training is tough, but you’d better stick with me! If you miss this chance, you’ll only drift further and further away from your destined partner! After all, your partner has already defeated our arch-enemy, the Dragon!”
“Guaaaaah!”
Black Thunder is following me, his heart racing with anticipation for his first encounter with Ren. He’s brimming with motivation. Well then, let’s go!
I took Black Thunder with me, used a portal to jump to a deep, remote part of the mountains—a great spot for efficient grinding—and defeated monsters to level up!
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Hahaha! Weak! Way too weak!”
“Guaaaaaaaah!”

Black Thunder must have been thrilled by the sight of my battle, for he joined the fray partway through. It was a nonstop battle—tearing them apart and hurling them away, over and over! There sure are a lot of griffins, aren’t there! Griffins are under Takt’s command and the enemies who killed Fleon-chan’s ancestors! I’ll slaughter them in the most gruesome way possible! And just as I was fighting…
“I hear there’s someone rampaging through my territory—”
“Brionac X!”
A huge griffin—one I felt like I’d seen somewhere before—came flying straight at me, so I struck first and blew its head right off! It’s the enemy that killed Fleon-chan’s ancestors!
“Ggyaaaaa!? Pygyaaa!”

As soon as the surrounding griffins finished off the giant one, they started fleeing at top speed, but I couldn’t care less! I know you lot have ties to Takt, don’t I? I’m going to slaughter every last one of you!
“You’ll become fuel for the power of darkness, I tell youuuuu!”
“Gwaaaaaaah!”

Black Thunder was absolutely thrilled with this line. Overnight… I took down every single griffin living in the mountains. Of course, I’ve given Black Thunder every possible enhancement. Since he was already on the verge of adulthood, by morning he’d grown into quite a fine specimen.
Well… it’ll still take a little while for Black Thunder to become King. I must proceed exactly as planned. So, after resting for one night, I used a portal to return to the village of my Father.
When I returned to the village that had been hit by the waves that morning, the villagers had already begun clearing away the damaged items. My father was among them.
“Naofumi.”
“Hm? What is it, Motoyasu…?”
My father replied to me with an annoyed expression.
“I’ll help out with the cleanup, too.”
“…Tell that to the villagers. Why are you going out of your way to tell me?”
As if to say, “Don’t get involved,” my Father turned his back and went back to work.
“Oh, it’s Spear Guy!”
Eeeeeek!? That’s Filo-tan’s voice!? I whirled around to see Filo-tan tilting her little head as she approached me.
“Good morning. I hope you’re having a lovely day.”
“Lovely?”
On the spot, I handed Filo-tan the dried meat I’d prepared for Filolial-sama.
“H-here, please help yourself.”
“Are you giving this to Filo?”
“Yes.”
After sniffing it a few times, Filo-tan took the dried meat from me.
“Yay, thanks!”
With that, Filo-tan walked away.

Phew… That’s a relief. Anyway, while we waited for the castle’s knight corps to arrive, we helped with the village’s reconstruction. When the Knights arrived, the Captain of the Knight Order bowed to me, then asked my Father—who had requested assistance from his capable soldiers—for the details of what had happened. We all decided to return to the castle together with my Father.

However, I managed to slip away and return to the castle ahead of everyone else. Apparently, that Trash wanted to hear the story from me—since my injuries were considered minor—before speaking with my Father. What a hassle. At that time, that Trash was worried about Crimson Swine’s condition while also showing signs of panic over the threat of the waves. That was after Father arrived, mind you. So, I arrived at the castle first and headed toward the throne room.
“Oh?”
Then, on my way to the throne room, I ran into my Finacée walking there.
I can tell. My Finacée is in a really bad mood right now. I know exactly the kind of vibe she gives off when she’s upset.
“You over there… Hey. I’m talking to you.”
I called out to her.
“Me?”
My finacée turned around.
“My name is Motoyasu Kitamura.”
“Ah… So you’re the Spear Hero… My name is Melty. I’m the Second Princess of Melromarc. I look forward to getting to know you.”

My finacée’s gaze is tinged with wariness. She probably thinks I’m on good terms with the Crimson Swine and is secretly trying to keep her distance. I gently take out Fleon-chan, Black Thunder, and Filo-tan’s shed feather and hand them to my finacée.
“Is this… a Filolial-sama feather? Are you bragging about monsters you’ve hunted? I… don’t find that kind of thing appealing.”
“That’s not it at all!”
Why on earth would giving her a Filolial-sama feather be seen as bragging about a hunt? That’s terrifying!
“It’s because I was sure you’d like them.”
Filo-tan’s feather is small, but I picked out the larger ones for Fleon-chan and Black Thunder. I was sure you’d like them, but your reaction is rather lukewarm.
“I’ll introduce you to Filolial-sama, who has these two large feathers, next time. And… you’ll be able to meet the owner of this feather right away.”
If we put the timeline in order, it should be right up next.
“No… I think it’s enough if the Spear Hero gets along well with my older sister. You really don’t need to worry about me or anything.”
My Finacée’s reaction is clearly tinged with rejection. Why on earth do I have to get along with some Crimson Swine!? I’m the guy who was told by Filo-tan to be sincere!

That said… how should I go about talking to my Finacée? Basically, it’d be easier to talk if Filo-tan were there… but it’s hard for me to bring it up myself. Above all, why is my Finacée in such a terrible mood? Based on my romantic experience… I’ll rely on my intuition and the facts so far to figure this out.

My finacée was summoned by that Trash, wasn’t she? Then, right after that, she got caught up in a conspiracy and ended up traveling with my future Father. We haven’t spent that much time together, but this is the time when I should be getting along with Filo-tan. By the time I met her, her bad mood had already subsided quite a bit. Could it be stress from that Trash or the Crimson Swine?

But… from what I’ve heard, based on how angry that Trash was and one side of the story, she apparently got so upset that she went to pick a fight with her Father. My finacée is, for better or worse, thoughtful and highly cautious. It’s probably true that her rash actions were triggered by her current bad mood. In other words, it’s not because of that Trash or the Crimson Swine… but due to some other factor.

Let’s consider another factor here. Based on the events of the loops so far, it seems the Finacée was being dragged along to negotiations between the Queen and foreign nations, and that’s when the Trash, seizing the opportunity, called the Finacée over out of longing. It reminds me of what happened when we all went to Faubrey.

Perhaps… she’s been stressed out by being hassled by Takt’s little pig of a sister or something like that? If we assume that her stress vanished by getting along with Filo-tan, it all makes sense. Hmm… in that case, I get the feeling that trying to cheer up my Finacée the wrong way might actually lead to results that deviate from what I expected.
“Right. Well then, let’s talk again when the opportunity arises.”
“Yes, that’s it then.”
And so, without bothering to curry favor with my Finacée this time, I headed straight over to Trash.
“Oh… Lord Kitamura, I’ve heard the story. I hear this battle was a fierce one. Could you tell me how Malty is holding up?”

Trash asks as if he’s worried about me. It makes me irritated to think back on the Trash who went to Siltvelt on that run. After all, he didn’t do a thing in that world. I suppose I could give him some kind of punishment… but for now, I have to get through this. I’ll play along and explain the situation in a way that sounds plausible.

“The wave monsters were stronger than I expected. I was relying on my knowledge of the game to act, but… I’m worried about what lies ahead. Don’t… worry about Myne; she didn’t suffer any irreparable injuries.”
Hearing my words, Trash puts a hand to his chest, looking relieved.
“I never would’ve thought a mysterious w—woman would emerge from the waves. Even I didn’t know about that.”
I explained what happened during the battle in the waves, sticking to details that wouldn’t cause any problems.
“Hmm… I’ve heard of the waves mentioned in legend, but it seems there’s still much we need to learn.”
The truth is, I know everything, but if I don’t pretend I don’t, who knows what’ll happen to Fleon-chan and my Father.
“When the next wave comes, we won’t lose. Defeat… makes us stronger.”
“Aye! That’s the spirit!”
It’s easy to imagine that if these were Father’s words, I’d be cursing him out—that’s just the kind of Trash I am these days.
“In that case, it would be best for you heroes to unite even more closely and tackle this together. I’ll be making preparations in the near future, so please wait for me.”
“Ah, well then…”

And so, after finishing my conversation with Trash, I pretended to rejoin Crimson Swine and managed to buy myself some free time. At the very least, I secured enough time until word of the kidnapping commotion reached me. It’s time to meet up with Black Thunder.
